thread:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert - elevated 5xx (500/502) rate detected for customer Everspring on dedicated pool vpc-dedicated-4 (canary slice). Metric: canary-5xx-rate = 12.3% over 5m, latency p95 spiking. Auto-rollout detected new artifact: redwood-artifact:2026-03-12-c3 (rolled to 10% canary). @maya_oncall has been paged.

maya_oncall: Acked. I'm looking. Can anyone confirm if this is isolated to the Everspring tenant or affecting other tenants on vpc-dedicated-4? :loud_sound:

sre_jordan: I see errors tied to the new runtime path. Logs show failing model shard init around the same deploy time. Error snippet: ```2026-03-12T21:02:11Z ERROR shard_init: failed to mmap weights: invalid header``` Looks like quantized kernel mismatch.

eng_lee: Confirming — kernel selection changed for that artifact. Can reproduce locally with artifact redwood-artifact:2026-03-12-c3 when using our q4_legacy kernels. On dedicated infra it causes OOM+500 for some model sizes.

maya_oncall: Impact check: Everspring reports degradations for their /generate endpoint since rollout started. We have ~40 active sessions, 12% failures for canary traffic. No other customers on that pool have reported, but telemetry shows increased error traces from same pool but same tenant id.

pm_anya: Everspring is in enterprise contract with strict SLA. They're on call. PM to inform legal/comms if extended.

sre_jordan: Short mitigation: pull canary traffic off artifact and pin canary slice to previous artifact (redwood-artifact:2026-03-05-b2). I'll orchestrate the pin and isolate the tenant from the problematic shard group.

eng_lee: I can push the pin. Command run to snapshot and pin: ```/infra/pin_artifact --pool vpc-dedicated-4 --slice canary --artifact redwood-artifact:2026-03-05-b2 --reason "rollback for Everspring errors"``` Expect ~30s to propagate.

maya_oncall: Please also run tenant quarantine to prevent further canary traffic mixing. Use emergency isolate mode, not full eviction. Command: ```tools/tenant_quarantine --tenant everspring --pool vpc-dedicated-4 --mode isolate --preserve-sessions true```

sre_jordan: Running both now. Pin command returned OK. Quarantine job queued; applying. I also updated routing policy to divert everspring canary traffic to reserve pool reserve-3 for safety: ```routing/traffic_shift --from canary --to reserve-3 --tenant everspring```

incident-bot: Action log: pin_artifact by eng_lee @1746004442, tenant_quarantine by sre_jordan @1746004450, traffic_shift by sre_jordan @1746004453.

eng_lee: After pin, rolling error rate down to ~0.4% on canary slice for Everspring. Latency p95 returning to baseline. Leaving monitoring for 10m then we'll drop quarantine if stable.

maya_oncall: Noted. I'll message Everspring support ops to say we've reverted their canary to previous artifact and isolated their sessions to reserve-3 while we monitor. Draft message to customer: "We detected an issue in a recent canary rollout to your dedicated pool; we've reverted the canary artifact and moved your sessions to a reserved slice while we investigate. No action required from your side; we'll follow up with root cause and timeline." Anyone want to edit?

pm_anya: Message looks good. Add: "We will schedule a follow-up call if there are any regressions."

eng_lee: Root cause leads: artifact used q4_legacy kernels which are incompatible with our newer kernel selection when the model tokenization uses packed-weight layout. Next steps: block that artifact from canary channels and add a validation gate in the compile stage. I'll open a PR for the gate and a tracking ticket.

sre_jordan: Creating incident ticket and tagging eng-runtime for fixes. Ticket: INC-2026-5678. Will include logs + repro steps.

maya_oncall: Handoff plan — I'm going offline in 45m. If still in mitigation, paging @kevin_ops as next on-call for SRE. Leave timeline and checklist in ticket:
- Verify canary error rate <=1% for 15m
- Confirm latency p95 back to baseline
- Confirm tenant session stability on reserve-3
- Release quarantine only after above checks

kevin_ops: I can take the handoff if needed. Ping me after 20m with status.

incident-bot: Monitor created: canary-5xx-rate-everspring (alert threshold 2%) — workspace alerting muted for 10m to avoid alert storms after mitigation.

eng_lee: PR opened: redwood/runtime#1452 adding compile-time kernel validation and artifact blocklist. Also marking artifact redwood-artifact:2026-03-12-c3 as blocked for canary and stable channels.

sre_jordan: Customer notified via support ticket #SUP-9821 and Everspring ops channel. Internal postmortem scheduled if incident > 2h.

maya_oncall: Monitoring window 30m started at 1746004460. Will update thread with final status or handoff. :thumbsup:
